_comment: How a fallen unit's body leaves the field, per faction (unit/modelling/motion/DeathFinish, Corpses). Client only.
The body first falls away from the killing blow (DeathFall, down by tick 18) and lies still; at 'start' (its
deathTime, ticks: 20 a second) the finish begins and lasts 'ticks'; the body is gone at start + ticks.
Over the finish: 'fade' 0..1 of its opacity goes (1 = gone; a fully faded body also shrinks away in its last
quarter, so armour drawn on it goes too), it moves 'rise' blocks (negative = sinks), loses 'squash' 0..1 of its
height (crumbling), 'flicker' 0..1 strobes it, 'glow' draws it full-bright. When it starts, one burst of
'particles' (at close zoom; fewer zoomed out, none at strategic zoom) in 'color' and 'color2', shaped by
'style': light, crumble, dust, leaves, seawater, static, gears, derez or sink (no burst).
Sunforged and Gravebound are lovish's words (Oct 29): pulverize into light; crumble. The rest are proposals.
Oct 29 captures: Gravebound, Horde, the derez and Stormcallers read faint; their bursts and finishes are larger.
The 'tidewrought' slot derezzes into light shards: that faction is being replaced by the AI faction (draft PR
379, glossy black with glowing light lines); move the entry to the new faction's key when it lands.
